files.README.md:
# sample-filing

This candidate contains synthetic data for learning the computation contract. Its numbers, thresholds and dates do not describe real entities or current rules. It is not a registered built-in pack.

The declaration selects normalized records and their hash-bound structured views. `records.json` is illustrative input data; matching this JSON file alone does not make it normalized evidence. Use your registered normalization workflow to retain it as a structured source before computing.

Read `docs/declarative-computation.md` in the workspace for the language and operation boundaries.
files.research.overlay.yml:
domain_pack:
  name: sample-filing
  version: 1.0.0
  compatible_research_yml_contract: '0.1'
  human_gated: true
computation:
  version: '1.0'
  arithmetic:
    mode: exact
    precision: 64
    scale: 2
    rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN
  clock:
    as_of: '2026-09-21T12:00:00Z'
    timezone: UTC
    ambiguous: refuse
    nonexistent: refuse
    search_days: 366
  tables: {}
  aggregations:
    sales:
      description: Synthetic observations
      selector:
        source_glob: sources/normalized/*.md
        records_pointer: /records
        row_key: /id
        allow_empty: false
      filter: record.kind == 'sale'
      group_by: []
      metrics:
        base:
          op: sum
          expr: record.base
          denominator: null
          unit: synthetic_currency
        withheld:
          op: sum
          expr: record.withheld
          denominator: null
          unit: synthetic_currency
      output_target: null
    expenses:
      description: Synthetic observations
      selector:
        source_glob: sources/normalized/*.md
        records_pointer: /records
        row_key: /id
        allow_empty: false
      filter: record.kind == 'expense'
      group_by: []
      metrics:
        deductible:
          op: sum
          expr: record.deductible
          denominator: null
          unit: synthetic_currency
      output_target: null
  graphs:
    filing:
      description: Synthetic worksheet
      inputs:
        income:
          kind: aggregation
          id: sales
          metric: base
          group: []
          reduce: null
        costs:
          kind: aggregation
          id: expenses
          metric: deductible
          group: []
          reduce: null
        withheld:
          kind: aggregation
          id: sales
          metric: withheld
          group: []
          reduce: null
      constants:
        rate:
          value: '0.20'
          unit: ratio
      nodes:
        net_profit:
          expr: income - costs
          unit: synthetic_currency
        gross_due:
          expr: max(0, net_profit * constants.rate)
          unit: synthetic_currency
        final_due:
          expr: gross_due - withheld
          unit: synthetic_currency
      output_mapping:
        box_income: income
        box_costs: costs
        box_profit: net_profit
        box_gross: gross_due
        box_withheld: withheld
        box_due: final_due
      output_page: null
  invariants:
    nonnegative:
      description: Declared synthetic constraint
      target: computed
      selector: null
      inputs:
        due:
          kind: graph
          id: filing
          output: box_due
      filter: null
      assertion: due >= 0
      severity: warning
      failure_message: Declared constraint requires review.
  cadence:
    review:
      description: Synthetic interval
      trigger:
        type: elapsed_units
        anchor: '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z'
        amount: 30
        unit: days
        calendar_policy: clamp
      lead_alerts:
      - amount: 2
        unit: days
      action:
        kind: status_flag
        target: review_due
